exec: pm.test('Status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Returns array of complaints', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('All results match category', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); j.data.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.category).to.equal('Water Supply')); });
pm.test('Status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Returns count', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.count).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Returns complaint data', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data._id).to.exist; });
pm.test('Status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Status updated', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.status).to.equal('In Progress'); });
pm.test('Status is 401 Unauthorized', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Access denied', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.false; });
pm.test('Status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Complaint deleted', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('AI returns priority and department', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.priority).to.be.oneOf(['Low','Medium','High','Critical']); pm.expect(j.data.department).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.data.summary).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.data.autoResponse).to.be.a('string'); });
